name: company-job-openings-scraper
title: Greenhouse, Lever & Ashby Jobs Scraper: Any Company
description: Scrape every open job from any company on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby or SmartRecruiters. Type company names, get one row per opening: title, department, location, remote flag, posted date and apply link. Filter by keyword, location or remote. No login, no API key.
